entries.summary: New Settings > App update in the GitHub download. Tap Update now to download and install the latest version. It also works in a Privacy Mode copy, even after you uninstall the original.

New switch, Show pause button, under Settings > Menus. It adds a widget button that pauses your fake location and resumes it at the same place. It replaces the press-and-hold menu on the round button. It is off by default and does not show on the floating map.
The floating map now hides Favorites, Roaming and Search when you turn them off for the map in Settings > Menus.
New switches under Settings > Menus hide the share button and the north arrow on the floating map. Both are on by default.
Capture now has its own widget button. It is off by default. Turn it on in Settings, Menus. It replaces the press-and-hold shortcut on the paste button.
Large GPX routes now import. A GPS Joystick export with thousands of points no longer gets skipped.
New Draw a line tool. Turn it on, then drag your finger on the map or the floating map. When you let go, you can walk the line or save it as a route.
The map now shows a countdown while the game's teleport cooldown is still running, and the time it ends. It stays after you press Stop.
The walk line no longer disappears when a new walk replaces the one in progress.
